title: Jensen Huang at HKUST: AI factories, leading 60 reports with transparency, and life's work
summary: Jensen frames AI as a reinvention of the computing stack and a new industry that turns energy into digital intelligence. He shares leadership lessons: confidence without certainty, strength with vulnerability, reasoning in public, and serving others' success. He also covers robotics and universities.

principles.text: Treat your work as your life's work, not a job, and keep reinventing yourself by learning daily.
principles.quote: the way of thinking about about whatever you do as your life's work rather than your job I think it it it is a a very big difference in your mind

principles.text: Confidence and certainty differ: be confident in direction, leave room for uncertainty so you keep learning.
principles.quote: confidence and certainty are not the same idea it is possible for you to be completely confident in pursuing a direction and not and allow room for uncertainty

principles.text: Strong leaders can be vulnerable and ask for help; this lets the whole team do the same.
principles.quote: vulnerability uh doesn't is not the absence of strength uncertainty is not the absence of confidence

principles.text: Leaders earn trust when every decision serves the mission and other people's success, not themselves.
principles.quote: leaders leaders are are fundamentally trusted when every single decision that is made is in the interest of the mission it's an interest of others

principles.text: Run a flat org by reasoning in front of everyone so the team reaches strategy together and hears the same thing.
principles.quote: I reason in front of everybody uh what we need to do uh we work together to come up with a strategy whatever strategy it is everybody hears at the same time

principles.text: Nvidia's biggest contribution was cutting the marginal cost of computing a million times, which changes behavior.
principles.quote: we've taken the marginal cost of computing MH and we reduced a buy a million times
